summary: Completed, unblocked signature judgments no longer retain a final candidate cursor or roots digest that only unfinished folds need. Candidate evidence, selected-result validation and all dependency links remain intact.

replay.detail: No graph replay. Existing completed rows shrink only when rejudged; no startup history scan or automatic database vacuum.

schema.detail: No table, index, column, kind or storage version changes. Completed rows use existing empty cursor strings.

rules.detail: No evidence or dependency retention changes. Incomplete, dirty and blocked judgments keep their resume state; authority invalidation still restarts completed judgments.

compatibility.detail: Old and new readers ignore the resume cursor of a completed fold and restart it when dirtied. Signature-reference writer activation remains a separate reader-first change.

recovery.detail: Reverting remains readable. Completed cursor data can be recomputed from retained canonical signature candidates; no authoritative evidence is removed.
